alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue per DTG guideline
alerts.message: Guidelines for patients on DTG-based first-line ART recommend checking VL every 6 months, reducing to 12 monthly only if VL < 50 copies/mL for >1 year with reliable adherence. The patient's last VL was 129 days ago (2025-09-15) at 20 copies/mL, which is within the 6-month window. However, no VL has been ordered at this visit or planned. If VL <50 has been sustained for >1 year (prior VL was 30 copies/mL in 2024-09-15), monitoring could be reduced to annual, but this should be explicitly documented and a 12-month VL ordered.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm VL <50 for >1 year to extend interval to 12 months, or order a 6-month VL if criteria not met.

alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring gap at follow-up
alerts.message: TDF is associated with nephrotoxicity and guidelines recommend routine laboratory screening for adverse drug events at sentinel sites. The patient's creatinine was 76 umol/L 38 days ago, which appears normal. However, no creatinine was ordered at today's visit. While the recent value is reassuring, ongoing periodic renal monitoring is part of routine safety screening for patients on TDF-containing regimens. The clinician's plan does not address renal monitoring.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue periodic creatinine monitoring per TDF safety guidelines at the next scheduled visit.
